lines.en: I want to show you something in the bathroom.
Hey, what do you got behind your back?
Nothing, just-- just something I want
to get Phoebe's opinion on for Valentine's Day.
Come on, I'm your older brother, ask me.
Um, which one of these do you think
would make your little sister look hotter
so your best friend would want to do her?
Why did you get me this?
Is this the video of the baby being born?
Why were you even watching it?
I thought maybe you got me porn for Valentine's Day.
Chandler, if you thought I was going to get you porn
for Valentine's Day, you were right.
Apparently, it's about a young girl
who moves to the big city.
You know, in search of stardom.
But ends up having sex with a lot of guys.
Anyway, you want to take a look?
Well, I'm not really in a sexy mood right now.
Well, remember the first time you saw Jaws?
How long it took to go back in the water?
We can't let this tape wreck Valentine's Day.
No wonder my mother hates me.
